lexical_dominance.definition: among gate-answer seeds, RRF top-10 overlaps FTS top-10 by >= 0.8

semantic_contribution.definition: among gate-answer seeds, >= 1 passage in the production RRF top-10 came only from the dense (vector) arm (bm25_rank is None)

summary.reading: High overlap + top-1 agreement + few dense-only slots => lexical-dominant retrieval; the vector arm mostly re-ranks the same lexical candidates. Dense-only slots are where the vector arm surfaced items FTS missed. This is a MEASUREMENT for the P-EXP-10 decision; no ranking or gate change is made here. Gate-abstained seeds are flagged as possibly-correct thin coverage, not assumed retrieval failure.
